buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic

Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 2 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Old Air field military station, Srinagar Old Air field military station, Srinagar Old Air field military station, Srinagar Old Air field military station, Srinagar Old Air field military station, Srinagar . 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 6. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 7. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 9. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 10. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 11. OEM

IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Sr Qua Nomenclature Scope of Work no ntity 1.Servicing and repair of following systems and Sub-system incl replacements of spares. 1.1 Lubrication System. 1.2 Fuel System. 1.3 Steering System. 1.4 Electric System. 1.5 Transmission System. 1. 1.6 Intake and Exhaust System. 1.7 Brake System. Life Extension Of HMVs Tatra 6X6 (Non Euro) (Ve 17 h Qty-17 ) in Northern Command Theatre 1.8 CTIS System. 1.9 Suspension System. 1.10 Cabin and Superstructure. 1.11 Diesel and Heater. 1.12 Overhaul of Engine assy incl FIP 1.13 Body work to incl denting and painting. 1.14 Road safety and other accessories incl NB C kit. 3. Methodology of Technical Evaluation Committee (TEC) - The TEC will be done to check complia nce to ATC & QR parameter based on physical/certification requirement. The list of items attached as Appe ndix A to this ATC (also Appendix A of NCQR & Draft RFP) will be produced before TEC by the seller along with certificates and OEM bill for approval as per specification given. The TEC will follow the following Meth odology. 3.1 Number of sample /items will be physically evaluated by TEC. 3.2 The TEC to decide date and place of evaluation which will be intimated to the vendor by E mail. 3.3 The sealed sample of the firm who has been given the supply order and which were lying with presidi ng officer of TEC should be handed over by the presiding officer of the TEC to the presiding officer of ATB. The ATB should compare the items supplied by the vendor with the sealed sample /items to ensure the qu alified items have been delivered. 3.4 The TEC will prepare compliance statement bringing out the extent of variations and differences, if a ny in the technical characteristics of the items compliant with the essential parameters.

3.5 The report to be prepare as per DPMF-23 of DPM 2025 format 4. Acceptance testing procedure (ATP) - Within 20 days of placement of supply order buyer and selle r will decide Acceptance testing procedure as per scope of work and qualitative requirement of the project, which will be followed for conducted by ATB (Acceptance testing board). Mention of this will be done while submitted ATB proceeding. 5. Rejection of sample Vehicle - In a scenario that the first vehicle fail to meet the tech specifications as mentioned in the bid and ATB rejects the life extension work, this contract will be treated to be null and void. No further vehicle will be offered for life extension work to the seller and consignee will not be liable t o make any payments to the vendor. 6. Disqualification on ground of national security-: Govt of india/complete authority reserves the ri ght to disqualify any vendor, should it be so necessary at any stage on ground of national security. 7. OEM Certificate -: In case the Bidder is not the OEM, the agreement certificate with the OEM for sour cing the spares shall be mandatory. However OEMs do not exist, minor aggregates and spares can be sour ced from authorized vendor subject to quality certification. 8. Export License -: The Bidder are to confirm that they have requisite license from their Government a nd Authorization from the manufacturing plant, in case they are not the OEM, to export the military / non- military goods to india. 9. Earliest Acceptable Year of Manufacture :- 2026 Quality / Life certificate will need to be enclosed with the Bill. 10. Quality assurance :- After the contract will be carried out by officers (ATB) constituted by Buyer /C ompetent authority. The mode of inspection will be Departmental Inspection and place will be decided by competent authority. 11. Product Support :- The agree to provide product support for the stores/services, assemblies/sub-asse mblies, fitment items and consumables, special Maintenance tools (SMTs)/Special test Equipment (STEs) s ub contracted from other agencies/manufacturer by the seller for a minimum Period of 05 (Five) years of w arranty after the delivery of Tatra 6X6 (Non Euro) Vehicle 11.1 In the event of obsolescence during the above mentioned period of product support in respect of an y component or sub system, mutual consultation between the seller and buyer will be undertaken to arrive at an acceptable solution including additional cost, if any. 11.2 Any improvement /modification /upgradation being undertaken by the seller or their sub suppliers o n the vehicle being Refurbished under the contract will be communication by the seller to the Buyer and if required by the Buyer, these will be carried out by seller at Buyer's cost. 11.3 There should be no major affect/deterioration of existing mechanical of the Tatra 6X6 (Non Euro) ve hicles during its Refurbishment work. 12. Life Certificate :- A Life Certificate of the equipment duly certified by the OEM to be Submitted alon g with the Bids, certifying at least five (05) years or 5000 kms (whichever is earlier) of product services life from the date of supply. 13. Price Bid issues :- Breakdown of cost with respect to material, Labor and overheads needs to be pr ovided by the L1 bidder through PNC/RA to arrive at reasonableness of the price. 13. Debarred/Blacklisted Firms :- Bid Submitted by firm/entity debarred /blacklisted by the Govt/Def f orces/PSU/PMFs/Police/any recognized agency will not be considered for evaluations. (Vendors are require d to submitted an undertaking duly verified by the registered CA) 14. Test and Compliance certificate :- To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder/OEM must possess f ollowing certificate/test report on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid);- 14.1 Test and compliance certificate in respect of all parameters in NCQR from Govt/NABL accredited La b/BIS/ISI certified. The quantifiable parameters for Eng gear box testing as per NCQR is attached as Appen dix B to this ATB. 15. Make in India (MII) :- Attention is drawn to Govt of India, public proc (preferably to make in India) o rder 2017(PPP MII Order) dt 15 Jun 2017 issued pursuant to Rule 153(iii) of GFR 2017 and Revision order dt 16 Sep 2020.

16. Technical :- Ability to carry out all tests/trails as per NCQR post completion of the life extension wor k of Tatra Vehicles and produce test equipment held by him in front of the TEC board in either at this prem ises (in Srinagar) or at Buyer's location. 17. Financial :- As per para 8 and 9 above in addition, the Bidder should have minimum turnover of rup ees 3 Crore or above in last three financial year. .
